children: Ionis announced FDA approval of ZANVASTRO (zilganersen) as the first disease‑modifying treatment for Alexander disease.
FDA approved ZANVASTRO for pediatric and adult Alexander disease; U.S. availability expected in coming weeks.
Pivotal trial met primary endpoint in ages ≥5: 33.3% stabilization in gait speed (10MWT) vs control at Week 61 (p=0.041).
ZANVASTRO 50 mg given quarterly via intrathecal injection; also showed motor improvement in ages 2–4 on GMFM‑88 at Week 61.
Favorable safety profile overall; most AEs mild/moderate; serious TEAEs less frequent than control, with aseptic meningitis noted as a risk.
FDA granted a Rare Pediatric Disease Priority Review Voucher; Recordati holds rights outside the U.S., submissions in EU/Japan expected 2027.
